miniProject.title: Stable neural value learning with frozen targets
miniProject.brief: Build the `policylab` deep value laboratory: a CartPole DQN baseline with replay and frozen targets, fixed-batch defect tests, overestimation evidence and full checkpoint resume. The run keeps raw curves and failures so later policy work inherits honest diagnostics.
steps: Reproduce off-policy semi-gradient divergence from the book start across a seed set beside its bounded solid-action on-policy twin, and pass Deep-ML 530 and Deep-ML 557 on CPU.
Extend the Hands-on Modern RL CartPole DQN in `deep/` with explicit replay and target state, pass Deep-ML 537, and separate exploratory training from greedy evaluation on held-out seeds.

Write frozen-batch DQN target tests that catch an online-target swap, a missing detach, a wrong gather and a replay corruption each, plus a vector autoreset probe that drops the reset handshake instead of storing it.

Sweep target lag under matched step budgets following Berkeley CS285 Homework 3, compare double against vanilla targets on identical samples passing Deep-ML 477, and keep Q scale, TD-error spread and gradient norm curves.

Checkpoint parameters, optimizer, replay contents and every RNG stream at an episode boundary, prove interruption equivalence against an uninterrupted run, and catch stale-target and evaluation-leakage defects.

Train CartPole across several seeds at a stated interaction budget on CPU, regenerate every chart from per-seed raw records including failures, and report stability with uncertainty rather than a best score.
deliverables: The `deep/` DQN laboratory with replay, frozen targets and full checkpoints.
Tests: frozen-batch target defects, replay corruption, autoreset handling and resume equivalence.
Lag sweep, double estimator comparison and diagnostics with multi-seed raw records and retained failures.

checks.name: Deep-ML 530: Linear Value Function Approximation with Semi-Gradient TD
checks.note: Pass after the hand computation; the tests check exact weight vectors.

checks.name: Deep-ML 557: Baird Counterexample Off-Policy TD Divergence
checks.note: Implement the counterexample step; keep your own diverging script too.

checks.name: Deep-ML 537: Experience Replay Implementation
checks.note: Check size tracking and circular overwrite before wiring the buffer.

checks.name: Deep-ML 477: Double Q-Learning Algorithm
checks.note: Pass the alternating-table updates; then compare against vanilla DQN.

checks.name: Berkeley CS285 Homework 3 DQN
checks.note: Sweep target lag at matched budgets; port or run in its own environment.

checks.name: Hands-on Modern RL CartPole DQN script
checks.note: Extend the training loop; keep greedy evaluation separate from exploration.

rubric.pass: Baird diverges on every seed while the solid-action twin stays bounded, and twins differ only in distribution.
rubric.strong: A slowed step size is shown to delay rather than remove the blowup.

rubric.pass: Frozen-batch tests fail on each injected target, detach, gather and replay defect.
rubric.strong: A live-sample loss drop is exposed as scale shrinkage by the frozen batch.

rubric.pass: Interrupted resume continues the identical loss trajectory with full state restored.
rubric.strong: Dropping each checkpoint piece in turn shows which resume check then fails.

rubric.pass: Lag sweep and double comparison use matched budgets with all seeds and failures retained.
rubric.strong: A losing configuration is kept and explains the operating point choice.

miniProject.feedsInto: Tested DQN machinery, replay discipline and checkpointing feed actor-critic, PPO, offline, model-based and capstone deep-RL evidence.
